title: When the Prom Wakes
author: Ada Eastwick
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
